answers.core: Given community feedback over the years, particle collision is quite commonly desired by users. While Godot 4.0 will provide a good implementation of particle collision, it still requires a bit of manual work which may be too high of a barrier of entry (especially in complex indoor levels). Also, many users will stick to `3.x` for their current 3D project.
answers.workaround: This can already be implemented with a custom shader as linked above.
